_comment_finding: Finding #02: Overly Broad CSP connect-src / img-src (CWE-942)
_comment_what_was_wrong: The CSP defined connect-src as 'self' https: wss: and img-src as https:. This wildcard scheme allowed malicious scripts (or XSS payload staging) to exfiltrate tokens, telemetry, or user state to arbitrary external HTTPS and WebSocket servers without restriction.
_comment_what_this_fix_does: Replaces broad wildcard schemes (https:, wss:) in connect-src and img-src with an explicit domain allowlist including the API backend, telemetry ingestion endpoint (Sentry), and authorized map tile providers.
_comment_before: connect-src 'self' https: wss:; img-src 'self' https: data: blob:;
_comment_after: connect-src 'self' https://api.worldmonitor.app wss://api.worldmonitor.app https://*.ingest.sentry.io https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org https://api.mapbox.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://api.worldmonitor.app https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org https://api.mapbox.com https://avatars.githubusercontent.com;

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-wm-bootstrap' 'strict-dynamic'; connect-src 'self' https://api.worldmonitor.app wss://api.worldmonitor.app https://*.ingest.sentry.io https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org https://api.mapbox.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://api.worldmonitor.app https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org https://api.mapbox.com https://avatars.githubusercontent.com; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none';
